body:
54 branches in this repository never reached `main`. Measured with full history:

| Branches | What they hold | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| 29 | Only a line in `prompts/runs.jsonl` (Oct 1–4) | `prompt.md` said to log "at the end of each run", which is after the merge, so every run (including no-op runs after the freeze) committed its log line to a new branch with no PR. |
| 15 | A second copy of a project another run landed in the same minute (`rain-twin`, `sweep-twin`, `loop-closure-twin`, …) | Four identical routines start within the same minute and race for the same idea. 9 of the 10 open PRs are these. |
| 7 | Finished projects that are not on `main` at all | `prompt.md` said "merge" but never "open a pull request", and cloud sessions don't open PRs unless asked. |
| 3 | Prompt and meta work, including `claude/ecstatic-turing-xzr8iq` (brief v1 and 33 audit fixes) | Same: pushed, never PR'd. |

## Changes
- **`prompt.md`**
  - A frozen note at the top: while the freeze holds, a run leaves no branch, commit, PR or log line.
  - **Landing work** replaces Workflow: start from `main`; land or close existing branches before new work; claim a project early with a PR; one project per PR; merge with a merge commit and confirm it is on `main`; leave a blocker comment if you can't land; push nothing when there's nothing to merge; never push to a merged branch; list every pushed branch before stopping.
  - The run-log line becomes the last commit before the merge, so it lands with the work.
  - Leaked work (a branch or PR not on `main` 24 hours later) is now a tracked error rate.
- **`CLAUDE.md`**
  - The "Moved" notice now says the move has not landed: fp-monorepo#6143 is open, so fp-monorepo has no `research/` yet.
  - Scheduled runs leave no trace while the repository is frozen.
  - A short "Land what you push" rule for every session.

No project files change. `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 233 projects, 2146 tests`.
